source_assessment.source_name: Northern Ireland planning statistics 2024/25 annual dataset
source_assessment.reliability: strong for administrative decision evidence; not physical-start, physical-completion or opening evidence
source_assessment.required_caveat: Rows support administrative planning/statutory-consent evidence only. They do not demonstrate built completion, opening, occupation, service delivery or outcomes.
source_assessment.ingestion_recommendation: Point-backed review candidates may be promoted only if the atlas accepts planning/statutory-consent milestones and carries the administrative-status limitations inline.

source_assessment.source_name: Northern Ireland planning statistics 2025/26 provisional quarterly publications
source_assessment.reliability: usable for aggregate current context; not usable for this point-event ingestion until the annual application-level dataset is published
source_assessment.required_caveat: Quarterly tables should not be treated as point-backed application rows without application IDs, row-level dates and Easting/Northing.
source_assessment.ingestion_recommendation: Retain as source audit context and revisit after the final 2025/26 annual application-level dataset is available.

source_assessment.reliability: strong for CRS parameter provenance; does not certify the DfI row point as a surveyed footprint
source_assessment.required_caveat: Converted points represent source row Easting/Northing locations only, not planning red-line boundaries or building footprints.
source_assessment.ingestion_recommendation: Retain source Easting/Northing, CRS URL and conversion method alongside WGS84 coordinates.

source_assessment.publisher: Department for Communities Historic Environment Division
source_assessment.reliability: strong for heritage status/location; usable for dated Heritage at Risk Date_Added administrative records with caveats, but not for physical-change dating
source_assessment.required_caveat: Status/listing/register dates are not construction, repair, completion or condition-improvement dates.
source_assessment.ingestion_recommendation: Use Historic Buildings records only when a dated designation field exists; use HARNI Date_Added rows only as heritage register/status events and preserve status limitations.

source_assessment.required_caveat: Council pages can document official announcements or project updates, but page-only leads must not be promoted without source-backed point geometry and compatible reuse terms.
source_assessment.ingestion_recommendation: Use as citation-only context or reject unless a source-backed point/boundary and compatible reuse terms are present.

caveats: All accepted candidates are administrative planning/statutory-consent records, not physical start, completion, opening or occupation evidence.
All accepted candidates are point-backed by official Easting/Northing fields converted from EPSG:29902 TM65 / Irish Grid to WGS84 using explicit CRS parameters.
No accepted candidate uses invented coordinates or generic geocoding.

Rejected official pages and rows include duplicate-project consents, 2025/26 quarterly aggregate-only releases, lower-priority fixture/equipment-only changes, lower-signal HMO/short-let-only rows, telecom/transport/street-furniture rows, minor domestic rows, sign/advertisement/display rows, page-only leads and status-only heritage sources.
No prediction, simulation, causality, service-performance, capacity, health, education, environmental, economic or heritage-condition outcome claim is made.
